snippet.title: Tormented Souls 2 Release Date Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Get ready to tackle complex puzzles and terrifying beasts, as an action-packed release date trailer for Tormented Souls 2 revealed that the survival horror advenutre is coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on October 23.
